summary.en: After you start living in Nagoya, submit a moving-in notice at the Citizens Section of the ward office for your new address. Bring the move-out certificate from your previous municipality (if you filed the move-out with a My Number Card, show the card instead).

text.ja: {住|す}み{始|はじ}めた{日|ひ}の{翌日|よくじつ}を1{日|にち}{目|め}として、14{日|にち}{以内|いない}（{要|よう}{確認|かくにん}）。{住|す}み{始|はじ}める{前|まえ}には{出|だ}せません。

text.en: Within 14 days; the day after you start living there is day 1 (to be checked). You cannot file before you start living there.

text.en: Citizens Section of the ward office for your new address (Ward Residents Section at a branch office)

text.ja: {窓口|まどぐち}でだけ{受|う}け{付|つ}けます。
text.ja_easy: {窓口|まどぐち}でだけ{受|う}け{付|つ}けます。

text.en: Bring: ID for the person at the counter (My Number Card, driver's licence, residence card, etc.). If you are a foreign national, also bring the residence card (or special permanent resident certificate) of everyone moving.

text.ja_easy: {持|も}ち{物|もの}：{転出|てんしゅつ}{証明|しょうめい}{書|しょ}。マイナンバーカードで{転出|てんしゅつ}{届|とどけ}をした{人|ひと}は、カードを{見|み}せます。{国民|こくみん}{健康|けんこう}{保険|ほけん}の{証|あかし}を{持|も}っている{人|ひと}は、それも{持|も}って{行|い}きます。
text.en: Bring: the move-out certificate (unless you filed the move-out with a My Number Card; then show the card). If you are on National Health Insurance or long-term care insurance, bring that card too.

text.en: If you have a My Number Card, bring the cards of everyone moving and know the PIN. If you move in from outside Nagoya and do not complete the card procedure within 14 days, the card becomes invalid (reissue 1,000 yen; to be checked).

text.en: You can request a copy of your resident record (juminhyo) at the same time. Request it then if you need it, for example for a bank.
